source_name: Prozorro national web portal — tender search (Пошук закупівель)
why_relevant: Official public front-end of Ukraine's central e-procurement database. Free-text + CPV (ДК 021:2015) filtered search over every above-threshold tender notice, bid and award decision, including banking services, ATMs, self-service terminals, POS and card processing. Highest-value pointer in the cell: enumerates buyer and supplier legal names that seed every other cell.

source_name: Prozorro Central Database public REST API (CDB, OpenProcurement API 2.5)
why_relevant: Machine-readable system of record. Paginated change-feed over all tenders, plans, contracts and awards with CPV classification, buyer/supplier EDRPOU identifiers, values, dates and document attachments. This is the backbone for automated, repeatable enumeration of every UA banking/payments public purchase.

source_name: Prozorro API technical documentation (openprocurement.api 2.5, ReadTheDocs, uk + en)
why_relevant: Authoritative schema reference needed to build a correct collector: tender data model, procedure types (openua, openeu, limited/negotiation, competitivedialogue, cfaua, esco), award/contract lifecycle, and the rule that classification.scheme must be CPV or ДК021. Defines exactly which fields carry buyer, supplier and value.

source_name: Prozorro developers hub — Розробникам / openprocurement
why_relevant: Official index of every machine-readable surface of the system: planning, tendering (all procedure families), contracting, framework agreements, standards registry, and the separate audit/monitoring API. Single best hub for discovering additional Prozorro endpoints.

source_name: Prozorro reference standards registry (ProzorroUKR standards — classifiers incl. ДК 021:2015/CPV)
why_relevant: Canonical machine-readable classifier lists used by the CDB, including the ДК 021:2015 (CPV) tree, unit codes and organisation scheme codes. Required to build the exact CPV filter set for banking/payments (e.g. 66110000 банківські послуги, 66170000 обробка фінансових транзакцій, 30123400 / 30230000 equipment, 32440000 телеметричне та термінальне обладнання, 72xxxxx software services).

source_name: BI Prozorro public analytics module (bi.prozorro.org)
why_relevant: Qlik Sense BI over all Prozorro procurement since 2015, refreshed daily; built by Transparency International Ukraine with EBRD and RBC Group. Fast way to size a category (spend by CPV, by buyer, by supplier, competition levels) before committing to a full API crawl, and to rank the top banking/payments buyers and vendors.

source_name: BI Pro Prozorro — professional analytics module (bipro.prozorro.org)
why_relevant: Extended/professional tier of the BI module with deeper cuts than the public one (richer dimensions, supplier and buyer profiling). Useful for competitor share-of-wallet analysis in banking/payments categories.

source_name: Prozorro monitoring/audit API (ДАСУ) — openprocurement.audit.api
why_relevant: State Audit Service (Державна аудиторська служба України, ДАСУ) monitoring decisions, conclusions (висновки) and liability records attached to specific tenders. Reveals contested, cancelled or irregular banking/payments procurements — a strong signal about buyer behaviour and vendor risk that the tender record alone does not show.

source_name: Prozorro Market — state e-catalogue (електронний каталог)
why_relevant: Below-threshold purchases (historically up to ~200k UAH) that bypass open tendering run through the e-catalogue instead, with product profiles and qualified suppliers. Relevant for computer/office/terminal hardware and small IT purchases that would otherwise be invisible in tender search; also lists qualified supplier pools. Digitalisation categories are administered by ЦЗО ДП 'УСС'.

source_name: Prozorro procurement specifications registry (specifications.prozorro.org)
why_relevant: Standard technical specifications/templates that buyers reuse in tender documentation. For banking/payments hardware and software this shows the required technical characteristics buyers write into specs — a direct read on product requirements and de-facto vendor lock-in.

source_name: Infobox Prozorro — official knowledge base
why_relevant: Official explanatory base for how procedures, thresholds, the e-catalogue and the BI modules work, plus rule changes. Needed to interpret status codes, procedure types and legal thresholds correctly, and to avoid mis-reading award data.

source_name: ProzorroUKR/openprocurement.api GitHub repository
why_relevant: Source code of the CDB itself. Definitive answer on field semantics, status enums, validation rules and release changes when documentation lags. Companion repo procedure_tools shows working API call patterns.

source_name: data.gov.ua — dataset 'Інформація про закупівлі згідно із Законом про публічні закупівлі'
why_relevant: The statutory open-data publication of Prozorro procurement information on the national open data portal (CKAN). Provides an alternative bulk/export route and a legal-status anchor showing the data is mandated open data rather than merely tolerated scraping.

source_name: DOZORRO — procurement monitoring portal and tools index (TI Ukraine)
why_relevant: Civil-society monitoring layer over Prozorro plus a curated index of third-party analytics tools built on the open data. Best single pointer for discovering additional derived sources, and its feedback/risk content flags problematic tenders and suppliers.

source_name: Clarity Project — procurement + counterparty analytics platform
why_relevant: Joins Prozorro tender/contract data to company registry data (EDRPOU), giving supplier profiles, contract history, geography and competitor views. Fastest route from a CPV hit to a full vendor profile when seeding the actor map for other cells.

source_name: Zakupivli.Pro — Prozorro tender mirror/search (uk + en)
why_relevant: Third-party mirror of Prozorro tender pages with clean, static, scrape-friendly HTML and stable per-tender URLs (/gov/tenders/{ua-id}) plus an English interface. Useful fallback when the official SPA is awkward to render, and its indexed pages surface well in search engines.

source_name: SmartTender.biz — authorised Prozorro electronic marketplace
why_relevant: One of the authorised brokers (майданчики) through which buyers and bidders actually transact. Publishes mirrored tender pages in uk and en plus commercial-procurement tenders that never reach the state CDB (private banks' own purchasing) — a route to non-public banking sector demand.

source_name: Держзакупівлі.Онлайн (dzo.com.ua) — authorised Prozorro marketplace
why_relevant: Long-standing authorised broker from the original Prozorro pilot. Mirrors state tenders and hosts commercial purchasing; useful as a redundant access path and for broker-side notifications/subscriptions on CPV categories.

source_name: E-Tender.ua — authorised Prozorro marketplace and e-catalogue guide
why_relevant: Authorised broker publishing practical guides to Prozorro Market and the e-catalogues, including which product categories exist. Helps map where terminal/computer/IT hardware demand is routed (catalogue vs open tender).

source_name: Prozorro.Продажі open data (prozorro.sale/opendata)
why_relevant: The sister SALE system (auctions, small privatisation, lease, asset disposal by state bodies and banks incl. Deposit Guarantee Fund asset sales). Adjacent to but distinct from procurement: relevant when banking equipment or bank-held assets are disposed of rather than bought. Has its own open-data/API surface and authorised platform list.

source_name: E-Data / spending.gov.ua — public finance transaction portal
why_relevant: Treasury-side view: actual payments made against contracts, plus published contract registers and financial statements of state entities. Closes the loop that Prozorro leaves open — award announced vs money actually paid to a banking/payments vendor.

source_name: Prozorro Bug Bounty / platform operations page (майданчикам)
why_relevant: Official page for authorised marketplaces — the authoritative route to the current list of authorised брокери/майданчики, which defines the complete set of legitimate mirror sources for UA tender data.

source_name: Zakupki.Prom.ua (Zakupivli.Pro) — largest accredited Prozorro marketplace, state + commercial tenders
why_relevant: Largest UA marketplace by volume (part of the Prom.ua/EVO group). Beyond republishing central Prozorro notices with its own CPV/DK021 classification and alerting, it runs a dedicated COMMERCIAL procurement stream (non-state buyers, incl. banks and retail) that never appears on prozorro.gov.ua. That commercial section is the single richest visible pool of private-sector banking/payments buying (terminals, ATMs, cash-in-transit, card issuance, IT).

source_name: Zakupki.Prom.ua commercial tenders section (комерційні закупівлі)
why_relevant: The specific below-threshold/private stream. Reported ~300+ active commercial buyers per month; these are exactly the non-state buyers (banks, fintech, retail chains) invisible to central-portal-only monitoring. Also reveals buyer identities and repeat-purchase cadence.
